Unit 11 — Create PT & The Exam

30% of your score is built in class (the Create PT, submitted in April); 70% is one morning in May (70 MC questions and four written responses in Bluebook). This unit produces both artifacts and the strategy to face them.

Lessons

IDTitleWhat you build / learn
11.1aCreate PT Launch: Pick Your Programthe five requirements, read from your own code
11.1bCreate PT: Build Day 1the list-centered core, visible from day one
11.1cCreate PT: Build Day 2the algorithm: sequencing, selection, iteration, parameters

11.2bCreate PT: Submit as Finalthe Digital Portfolio, checked twice, confirmed

11.5aExam Eve: Logistics & StrategyMay 14, 8 AM, Bluebook, PPR in hand — then sleep

Concepts this unit owns

Everything is exam-aligned: the PT requirements are the CED's own wording, the MC strategy targets the CED families, and the error-table method is data-driven studying. CED: every family, one last time, for points.
